meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过二维码或配对码直连 WhatsApp 频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中直接连接 WhatsApp 发送或接收消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel via QR code or pairing code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to directly connect WhatsApp in your app to send or receive messages.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过 WhatsApp 收发消息、文件、表情反应和打字指示，支持群聊和私聊。
howto.when: 当用户运行 /setup 流程或手动执行安装步骤，并通过二维码或配对码完成 WhatsApp 手机绑定后触发。

say.text: 帮我用 WhatsApp 给张三发一条消息，说“明天见”。
say.note: Claude 会通过已绑定的 WhatsApp 发送消息。

say.text: 把这张图片通过 WhatsApp 发到我的家庭群。
say.note: Claude 会发送图片到指定群组。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can send and receive messages, files, emoji reactions, and typing indicators via WhatsApp, supporting both group chats and direct messages.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user runs the /setup flow or manually executes the installation steps, and completes WhatsApp phone binding via QR code or pairing code.

say_en.text: Send a WhatsApp message to John saying 'See you tomorrow'.
say_en.note: Claude sends the message via the linked WhatsApp.

say_en.text: Send this image to my family group on WhatsApp.
say_en.note: Claude sends the image to the specified group.
